We look for aliens in all kinds of ways; through telescopes, in radio signals etc., but what if the answer to the existence of alien life has been right in front of us this whole time - on the moon? A new theory suggests exactly that. Today we explore that topic, along with questions about weird animal habits, the shifting of Tornado Alley, throwing our trash into volcanoes, and the legacy of the Space Shuttle, all on this month’s Lightning Round video.
